data.name: Jameena
data.gender_notes: Jameena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jamaana' meaning 'a collection' or 'a gatherer'. In Islamic culture, Jameena represents the idea of gathering knowledge, wisdom, and blessings. The name is often given to girls who are expected to become wise, knowledgeable, and collectors of good deeds. The name Jameena carries the meaning “Gatherer, Collector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jameena usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer, collector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jameena total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
